history.text: Turco-Egyptian and later Mahdist rule reached the southern Nile basin.
The region was administered separately under Anglo-Egyptian rule.
The first civil war was fought against the Khartoum government.
The second civil war ended with a comprehensive peace agreement.
Independence came on 9 July after a referendum.

worthSeeing.title: Sudd wetlands:
worthSeeing.text: One of the world's largest wetlands, formed by the White Nile.

worthSeeing.title: Boma National Park:
worthSeeing.text: Grasslands crossed by a large white-eared kob migration.

worthSeeing.title: Nimule National Park:
worthSeeing.text: Hippos and the Nile at the Ugandan border.
